title: Volume Relief on Dropped-Batch Points for Busy Shoppers — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
For Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, a shopper who has been working steadily earns volume relief on a dropped-batch violation.

**Clause.** The volume relief counts the batches for which the shopper was paid base pay less than one whole month before the day the violation is booked: 10 or more such batches earn a relief of 3 points; from 5 up to 9 (one fewer than 10) earn a relief of 1 point; fewer earn no relief.

The count is taken from the shopper's batch pay ledger in Cartwise Shopper Batches: each batch-base pay posting dated less than one whole month before the booking day counts once. Postings of other pay components do not count.

## Relief table

| Batches paid base pay in the month before booking | Volume relief |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 3 points |
| 5 to 9 | 1 point |
| 0 to 4 | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical ledgers)

- 10 base-pay postings in the month: relief of 3 points. 9 postings: relief of 1 point.
- 5 postings: relief of 1 point. 4 postings: no relief.
- A batch paid base pay five weeks before the booking day is outside the month and does not count.
